closure.policy: x_target-x_source+wrap*H=delta. H is free, never forced zero. Without a winding cycle it is unidentifiable; optimizer gauge is not a measured closure.
closure.uncertainty: L1 optimum can be nonunique; residual selection is conditional, not photographic certification.

compatibility.policy: One complete cyclic state configuration, then simultaneous maximum-weight compatible whole-hypothesis subset; omitted windows abstain.
